Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the query by treating “region” as a country (focusing on Lebanon/Syria) and steering the search toward a country north of Israel. The question’s phrasing (“region home to Israel and the location of Operation Earnest Will”) points to a regional construct (USCENTCOM’s AOR, which includes the Persian Gulf; with the region immediately north being USEUCOM). This early misclassification set the workflow on an irrelevant track (Lebanon establishment/independence dates) and led to subsequent confirmation bias, directly causing pursuit of the wrong answer.
